name: Midnights
llm_description: Midnights is Taylor Swift's tenth studio album, a concept record about thirteen sleepless nights scattered through her life, blending moody synth-pop and dreamy production with introspective late-night confessionals.
llm_emotion_analysis: Nocturnal and introspective; restless self-examination, insecurity, and revenge fantasies delivered with a sleek, hazy cool.
llm_overall_public_reception: Commercially dominant and mostly positive; broke streaming records and swept the top ten of the Billboard Hot 100, winning Album of the Year, though some critics found it less adventurous than her prior work.
